dailyCheckin.title: Daily Mental Health Check-in
dailyCheckin.subtitle: Record and track your daily feelings so you get to know yourself better every day
dailyCheckin.overview: The daily mental health check-in service lets you easily record your mood, feelings, and stress level each day. The system analyzes your data and shows mental health trends in easy-to-read graphs, helping you see the big picture of your mental health and improve your habits where it matters.
dailyCheckin.f1Desc: Pick an emoji and write a short note in just a few seconds a day
dailyCheckin.f2Desc: View weekly and monthly summaries of your mood
dailyCheckin.f3Desc: Set a reminder so you never forget to check in
dailyCheckin.f4Desc: All data is encrypted and stored securely
dailyCheckin.s1Desc: Create a free account in just a few minutes
dailyCheckin.s2Desc: Pick the emoji that matches how you feel today, and add a short note if you like
dailyCheckin.s3Desc: Review graphs and statistics of your past moods to understand yourself better
dailyCheckin.s4Desc: The system suggests activities and articles suited to your state of mind

assessment.title: Basic Mental Health Assessment
assessment.subtitle: Standardized stress/depression questionnaires to help you understand your mental health status
assessment.overview: The basic mental health assessment uses academically validated standard questionnaires, such as PHQ-9 for depression and GAD-7 for anxiety, to help you understand your current mental health status. Results come with basic advice and self-care guidance.
assessment.f1Desc: Uses assessment tools recognized by international mental health organizations
assessment.f2Desc: See your results immediately after finishing, with easy-to-understand explanations
assessment.f3Desc: Compare results from each assessment to see your mental health progress
assessment.f4Desc: Receive advice tailored specifically to your assessment results
assessment.s1Desc: Select the one you want, such as stress, depression, or anxiety
assessment.s2Desc: Answer honestly. It takes about 5-10 minutes
assessment.s3Desc: The system shows your score with an easy-to-understand interpretation
assessment.s4Desc: Read the advice and self-care guidance tailored to you

listeningSpace.title: Chat With Nong Muk Huang Yai
listeningSpace.subtitle: A private chat to talk through your feelings without fear of being judged
listeningSpace.overview: Nong Muk Huang Yai is a chatbot designed to be a companion when you need someone to listen, whether late at night or on holidays. The chatbot is always ready to listen, using AI to respond with empathy, safety, and confidentiality.
listeningSpace.f1Desc: Any time of day, the chatbot is ready to listen, with no days off
listeningSpace.f2Desc: The AI is designed to respond with empathy and without judgment
listeningSpace.f3Desc: Every conversation is kept strictly confidential
listeningSpace.f4Desc: In an emergency, the system immediately suggests support channels
listeningSpace.s1Desc: Open the chat window and start typing right away
listeningSpace.s2Desc: Share what's on your mind. The chatbot will listen and respond with understanding
listeningSpace.s3Desc: The chatbot offers encouragement and ways to cope with your feelings
listeningSpace.s4Desc: If you need more help, the system will suggest professionals or hotlines

relaxation.title: Emotion Matching Mini-Game
relaxation.subtitle: Relax and reflect on your emotions with a fun card-matching game, before or after your assessment
relaxation.overview: The Emotion Card Matching mini-game helps you relax and practice noticing your own emotions by matching emotion-word cards with situations that reflect them. It's great for a short play before starting an assessment, or whenever you want to de-stress.
relaxation.f1Desc: Match every pair of cards in just a few minutes
relaxation.f2Desc: Connect emotion words with everyday situations
relaxation.f3Desc: Helps ease tension before starting a real assessment
relaxation.f4Desc: Come back whenever you want to take a mental break
relaxation.s1Desc: Tap play to open the emotion-matching card board
relaxation.s2Title: Flip two cards at a time
relaxation.s2Desc: Flip two cards each turn to find a matching pair
relaxation.s3Desc: Match every emotion word with its situation card
relaxation.s4Title: Move on to the next step
relaxation.s4Desc: When you finish, you'll continue to the assessment automatically if you came from the homepage, or you can return to the services page
